Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human metastatic prostate adenocarcinoma cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on LNCaP cells, an androgen-sensitive epithelial prostate adenocarcinoma line established from lymph node metastasis of a 50-year-old male and used for androgen receptor and prostate cancer enhancer biology.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from adherent prostate cancer cells: nuclei are isolated from the cultured population, accessible chromatin is tagmented in bulk with Tn5 transposase, and sequencing captures shared regulatory accessibility.
